config.prompt_content: Read the sentences and hypothesis above and output the set of sentences that you think can be account (proof) for the hypothesis. Think step by step and thoroughly. Your output should be your reasoning and then the final answer with the following format: sent{first sentence number}&sent{second sentence number}&... No explanation, no other text, no other format. Remember that the size of the ground truth set can vary from 1 to any arbitrary number and order of the sentences does not matter. In addition, there is only one correct answer; thus, any other set with smaller or bigger number of sentences is incorrect. Some examples of valid outputs: sent1&sent2&sent3 / sent10 / sent12&sent3
